b: Our Spring 2027 Term is now live! We have a whole host of brilliant tutors and poetry courses ready for you to pick from and, as they tend to sell out really fast, we’ve made this Spring 2027 Quick Course Guide to help guide you to the right course.
Asynchonrous Online courses with no “Live” elements, suitable for students in all time zones.

Poetry Mapping: Plotting Uncertainty
Explore the relationship between poetry and the map, between place and language, and learn how physical location, and geographic navigation, can affect your poetics and even your sense of identity.

Writing Through Grief & Challenging Times
This new course aims to support poets who wish to write about their experiences of grief and adversity, exploring those deeply personal and difficult times in our lives.
Transcend culture, languages, and genres to write poems and translations in response to wide readings.
Advanced and in-depth poetry courses focusing on craft and theory.
Receive thoughtful critiques of 5 poems from your peers and an esteemed tutor.
Short, intensive poetry courses focusing on writing and inspiration.

The Haunted House Studio
Brave the haunted house in your writing, as we unlock the classic horror trope in this Studio course.

Alternative Ecopoetry
In an increasingly-cynical world, how can we authentically engage with the nonhuman in our writing, and bring poetics into our activism, field work, and rituals?

Pathways Through Poetry is our structured programme for poets, running over two years and comprising of 6 x termly modules of 10 sessions, each with a different focus and curriculum. Each module builds on the previous one and aims to give students a thorough journey through, and grounding in, poetic craft, technique, and culture. If you have any questions about the programme please email [email protected].

Pathways through Poetry: Module 1
A blank page – do or don’t? The first module in our Pathways Through Poetry series. Jump in and we’ll guide you through the journey to poetic success!

Pathways through Poetry: Module 2
The second module in our Pathways Through Poetry series: ‘Syllable, Stress and Metre’. Take the next step on your journey to poetic success! You can only book this course if you completed Pathways Module 1. If you did not attend this workshop last term, please email us at [email protected].

Pathways through Poetry: Module 3
The third module in our Pathways Through Poetry series: ‘Forms and the Performance of Forms’. Take the next step on your journey to poetic success! You can only book this course if you completed Pathways Module 2. If you did not attend this workshop last term, please email us at [email protected].

Pathways through Poetry: Module 4
The fourth module in our Pathways Through Poetry series: ‘Getting Experimental’. Take the next step on your journey to poetic success! You can only book this course if you completed Pathways Module 3. If you did not attend this workshop last term, please email us at [email protected].

Please note our Advanced Workshops are by application only, so if you are a new student or wishing to book a workshop with a tutor you haven’t worked before, please send across 3 samples of your poetry to [email protected] before you book your place.
